request_existing_models.details: Current gpioc.c is effectively a stub. Implement enough GPIOC register behavior to publish output level changes through api_signal_set() for all 16 pins, or at minimum PC14 and PC13. Use signal_id=(2*16)+pin_number, so GPIOC14 is signal_id=46 for SPI4 CS2/ms5611_ext and GPIOC13 is signal_id=45 for SPI4 CS4/icm20602_ext. Return 0x12 for that WHOAMI read and implement a small stateful register map for common Invensense initialization reads/writes rather than a one-off board-validation bypass.
